title: The right hand panel says labels and tools, never sentences
goal: The user, answering this task's card: no sentences in the panel, just labels and tools; an explanation, if one is needed, lives in a tip when you point at a label, or behind a question mark in the section header. Today a video's panel still shows lines like 'Any property can be keyed, even color and stroke width.', 'drag the diamonds on the lane' and 'Nothing yet. Add one with the plus above.', and dozens more across the other sections.
notes: Filed by panel-copy-and-flag-descriptions-have-a-length-b (2026-09-24). The gate is Tests/PhotonzCoreTests/PanelCopyBudgetTests.swift: it scans every panel file (name contains Inspector, ends PartSettings.swift or Panel.swift, or PanelSectionsFooter.swift) with CopyBudget.phrases(inSwift:) and fails any shown string over CopyBudget.panelLine (60) characters. `allowed` holds the 32 offenders of 2026-09-24 by their first 40 characters, per file; striking one off is enforced (theAllowanceOnlyShrinks). Biggest: PlacementInspector (12), ComponentPanel (5), FrameColumnsInspector (5), ArrangementInspector (2), ColorStylePanel (2), LayerEffectsInspector (2), BlendModeInspector, MotionList none (fixed), PanelSectionsFooter (1). A few may be strings the scanner cannot see are hover tips (built in a helper not named ...Help/...Tip): rename the helper to end in Help and it drops off. Read UX-PATTERNS §4 'How much a section may say' first: condition notes (reach notes, legibility notes) are a different register but still must fit the line. The budget (40 vs 60) has a card on this task; build to its answer.
acceptance: No line of text shown in the right hand panel is longer than 40 characters, the limit the user picked on the card, and none is a sentence: the panel budget test enforces 40 and its allowance list is empty

On a video at Next defaults, with a clip picked and with a sound picked, the Properties, Time, Sound, Fades, Appearance, Effects and Captions sections show only labels, values and controls, in one picture in the audit set beside a before picture
No sentence that was the only place a limit or scope was written down is lost: it moved to the control's hover tip, or to a question mark in the section header where a section really needs explaining
The walks that read these sections still pass

log.note: Waiting on the card: which line length (40 or 60 characters) the rewrite aims for

decision "How long may a line of text in the right hand panel be?" resolved: Up to 40 characters (We should have no sentences in the panel, just labels and tools. it’s weird ui to have paragraphs where tools should be. We can have popovers when hovering over a label to maybe explain something if you’re curious. or even have a pane have a question mark icon in its header only if something needs explaining. But I am sick of seeing a bunch of text in tool panes)

triage 2026-09-26: moved to p1 and the acceptance rewritten to the card's answer (40 characters, no sentences, explanations in hover tips or a header question mark). The user's words on the card ('I am sick of seeing a bunch of text in tool panes') are a direct complaint about the focus surface, and today's picture of a video's panel (/tmp/photonz-playtest/transition-picker-at-a-cut-walk/1-two-clips-meet-sc.png) still shows three sentences: Animating 'Any property can be keyed, even color and stroke width.', Fades 'drag the diamonds on the lane', Effects 'Nothing yet. Add one with the plus above.'. The budget in CopyBudget.panelLine is still 60, so those pass today.

Review before building: the mocks print two of the offending lines themselves (video-audio.html Fades 'drag the diamonds on the lane', video.html 'Any property can be keyed'); the user's card answer (no sentences, explain behind a header question mark) is later and more specific, so both moved behind a new header question mark (SectionHelpMark: hover tip + click popover). Said so in the audit's rough.

Built: CopyBudget.panelLine 60 -> 40, new CopyBudget.isSentence; PanelCopyBudgetTests fails any shown line over 40 or a sentence, allowance list and shrink test removed (all 32 + the new 40-char offenders cut). Scanner fixes, unit tested: a tip declared as 'static let xHelp =' with its words on the next line is a tip; 'systemImage:' is not copy; '...AlertMessage' declarations are an alert's, not the panel's; the probe-only ViewBuildMeter note() log line is hidden. About 65 lines cut to labels across 15 panel files with each explanation moved to .panelHelp; Blending and Masked by popover lists show names only (explanation per row as tip); core instanceArrangementShortReason shortened. Files are shared with Current, so Current gets the shorter copy too (the user's rule is about the panel, not a release). UX-PATTERNS §4 updated to the 40/no-sentence rule.

Verified: Scripts/test.sh 9990 tests green; 11 walks green (sound-fades-in-the-panel updated to read the Fades question mark's tip via expect tooltip, plus transition-picker-at-a-cut, transitions-at-a-cut, border-offset, motion-swings-a-layer, layers-combine, group-says-it-overflows, fill-the-flow(+menu), panel-sections, placement). Before/after captures (screen recording granted, screen unlocked) in queue/audits/2026-09-27-panel-labels-*.png. Left rough, no task: panel text built in PhotonzCore (e.g. LayerStyleSelection.note, GroupOverflow.sentence as a tip) is invisible to the source scan; the ones found were cut by hand.

No panel line over 40 characters or written as a sentence: PanelCopyBudgetTests enforces 40 + no sentences with an empty allowance. About 65 lines across 15 panel files cut to labels, explanations moved to hover tips; Fades and Properties got a header question mark (hover tip + click popover). 9990 tests green, 11 affected walks green at Next defaults, before/after captures of a clip and a sound picked in queue/audits/2026-09-27-panel-labels-not-sentences.json.
